title: Explanation
description: Output of `rule explain`. With --rule: a RuleExplanation — `operators` is the glossary (each distinct construct once, with meaning/gotchas), `tree` is the structure and every node's `operator` BACKLINKS into `operators[].id`. With --computation: a ComputationExplanation — the computed field, common precondition + per-alternative precondition/operation, messages, gloss. Either mode is tolerant: a construct the converter doesn't model yet returns `{explained:false, reason, …}` instead.

text.description: (rule) the canonical EN rendering of the whole condition

iterates.description: (rule) whether the condition ranges over a repeatable group

iterationGroup.description: (rule) the repeatable group iterated over; present only when `iterates` is true

polarity.description: (rule) the rule's firing polarity — the constant A12 truth an agent needs so it doesn't explain the rule backwards

firesOn.description: a rule condition is TRUE on a VIOLATION — it models the state to reject, not the requirement

note.description: the human guidance: explain the condition as the forbidden case; the message states the requirement positively

commonPrecondition.description: (computation) the guard shared by all alternatives, if any

precondition.description: the tier's guard (absent for the single unconditional alternative)

messages.description: the stored error texts by locale, raw + uninterpolated — a computation's self-validation messages, or a rule's error messages (G10, the modeler's own NL); same shape `rule read` surfaces

explained.description: (not explained) always false — the construct is not yet modeled

canonicalText.description: (not explained, rule) the raw kernel condition text, preserved verbatim

operators.description: glossary of the distinct operators used, in encounter order; tree nodes reference these by id

id.description: catalog operator-id; the key tree nodes backlink to via `operator`

kind.description: OPERATOR | PREDICATE | FUNCTION | CONSTANT ("?" if the id is unknown to the catalog)

gotchas.description: author-relevant surprises the kernel is silent on

kind.description: the model value-kind, or "GROUP" for a group reference

node.description: one node of a condition's structure. `operator` backlinks into operators[].id; `text` is the rendered DSL of this subtree. `children` are the operator-bearing operands, in source order; value operands (fields, literals) are shown in `text`, not as nodes.

operator.description: operator-id — a key into the `operators` glossary

text.description: the rendered DSL of this subtree

ruleExplanation.description: a condition projected for understanding (the same shape as the top-level --rule output)

operation.description: a computation operation projected as a formula: rendered text, operator glossary, referenced fields

text.description: the rendered DSL of the value expression
